sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Sparkling Silver Eyelash Evil Eye Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Make a chic statement with this uniquely detailed eyelash evil eye bracelet. Adorned with shimmering crystals, this high-fashion charm is the perfect protective accessory. To maintain its brilliant silver luster, we recommend keeping it away from moisture and perfumes, storing it safely in a dry place after every wear.
